summary: Alarum Technologies Ltd., an Israeli dual-listed software company, filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of its Annual General Meeting of shareholders, a proxy statement, proxy card, and ADS voting instruction form (the US-equivalent annual meeting notice and proxy solicitation). The AGM is set for December 30, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. Israel time in Tel Aviv, with a December 1, 2026 record date. Agenda items are routine: re-appointing PwC Israel as auditor, re-electing Class I directors Rakefet Remigolski and Yehuda Halfon to three-year terms, and presenting FY2025 financials. The board recommends approval; no transaction terms exist. No special-situation angle applies.
